moblocator.config.title: Mob Locator Configuration
moblocator.config.usePerMobColors.toolti: When enabled, use each mob's individual color as the icon fill color instead of the global Hostile/Passive colors.
moblocator.config.useBlackOutlines.toolt: When enabled, use black outlines instead of the Hostile/Passive colors.
moblocator.config.hostileColor.tooltip: Color for hostile mobs and neutral mobs when provoked.
moblocator.config.passiveColor.tooltip: Color for friendly mobs and neutral mobs until provoked.
moblocator.config.invisibleColor.tooltip:
Outline color for invisible mobs when shown, overriding the normal outline.

Greyed out when Show Invisible Mobs is disabled.
moblocator.config.blacklistedMobs.toolti:
Add mob names to prevent them from showing on the locator bar.

Use the display name exactly as it appears in-game (e.g. Creeper, Iron Golem, Cave Spider).
moblocator.config.perMobColors.tab.toolt:
Customize the icon fill color for each individual mob.

Only active when Use Per-Mob Colors is enabled in the Settings tab.
moblocator.config.perMobColors.tooltip:
Each entry sets the fill color for one mob.

Format: Mob Name=#RRGGBB
Example: Creeper=#0DA70B

Use the mob's display name exactly as it appears in-game.
